subject: [PATCH 47/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to N_MEMORY_RECLAIM instead of N_MEMORY_COMMON

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer Gregory Relay noted that the patch restricts reclaim to N_MEMORY_RECLAIM nodes by modifying various functions in mm/vmscan.c, but did not provide any specific feedback or suggestions for improvement.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the reclaim process to nodes that have opted into it by setting the N_MEMORY_RECLAIM state, rather than serving all common memory. This change affects kswapd and its interfaces, as well as watermark management and direct reclaim. Private nodes that permit reclaim will now get watermarks again and be boosted, while those without this state keep zero watermarks. The patch also updates various functions to reflect these changes, including si_mem_available() and the hopeless-kswapd recovery on page free.
